时笙一睁眼就看到无边无际的火焰，而她正站在火焰中，皮肤滚烫，口干舌燥，头发早就化成了灰烬。

身上的衣服不知道是什么做的，没有损坏，但是依旧抵挡不住那炽热的温度。

“我去，这时间点选得真特么的好啊！”这是要烧死本宝宝啊！

时笙环顾四周，想要找到出去的地方。

然而这里只有火焰，无边无尽，看不到尽头，也看不到任何物体。

灼热的气浪一层接一层的席卷而来，她醒过来这么会儿，就有些撑不住了，她甚至听到裸露在外的皮肤被烤得滋滋的响。

掀桌！这特么的什么鬼地方！

系统你出来，老子要和你聊聊人生。

“师叔，师叔，你醒醒。”

“师叔，醒醒……”

突兀的声音在整个空间响起。

有人？

“师叔，这是幻境，你快醒醒啊！”

时笙一愣，柳眉微蹙，幻境？

她这是进玄幻小说了？

妈的，就算是玄幻小说，怎么一来就是幻境？这特么不科学啊！

咬咬牙，时笙闭上眼，让自己沉下心来，四周火焰燃烧的声音渐渐远去，温度也慢慢的下降，周身的疼痛消失，她感觉到了一股清凉。

“呼……”时笙猛的睁开眼，胸口快速的起伏了几下。

视线所及之处，是一个长相颇为可爱的少女，正一脸担忧的看着她，见她睁开眼，如释重负的松口气。

“师叔，吓死我。”少女脸上是劫后余生的庆幸。

时笙不动声色的打量了少女几眼，她身上穿的白色的长袍，和这身体穿的款式差不多，只是颜色不一样。

这身体的长袍颜色是深蓝色的。

亲传弟子。

脑中自动浮现这么几个字。

剧情和记忆纷沓袭来，时笙脑中昏胀，眼前发黑，她听到少女焦急唤她的声音，但是意识离她越来越远。

As soon as Shi Sheng opened her eyes, she saw boundless flames, and she was standing in the flames. Her skin was hot, her mouth was dry, and her hair had long been turned into ashes.

I don’t know what the clothes on my body are made of. They are not damaged, but they still cannot withstand the scorching temperature.

"I'll go, you chose this time really well!" This is going to burn this baby to death!

Shi Sheng looked around, trying to find a way out.

However, there is only flame here, it is endless, there is no end in sight, and no object can be seen.

The scorching waves of air swept over her one after another, and she couldn't hold on for so long after waking up. She even heard the sizzling sound of her exposed skin being roasted.

Flip the table!What the hell is this place!

When you come out of the system, I want to talk to you about life.

"Uncle Master, Uncle Master, wake up."

"Uncle, wake up..."

A sudden sound echoed throughout the space.

Anyone?

"Uncle Master, this is an illusion. Wake up!"

Shi Sheng was stunned for a moment, his eyebrows furrowed slightly, a fantasy?

Is she getting into fantasy novels?

Damn it, even if it’s a fantasy novel, why is it a fantasy in the first place?This is so unscientific!

Gritting her teeth, Shi Sheng closed her eyes and calmed herself down. The sound of burning flames around her gradually faded away, the temperature slowly dropped, the pain all over her body disappeared, and she felt a coolness.

"Huh..." Shi Sheng opened his eyes suddenly, and his chest rose and fell rapidly several times.

Wherever he could see, he saw a rather cute-looking girl looking at her with a worried expression. Seeing her open her eyes, he breathed a sigh of relief.

"Uncle, you scared me to death." The girl's face showed the joy of surviving the disaster.

Shi Sheng looked at the girl calmly. The white robe she was wearing was similar to the one she was wearing, but the color was different.

The color of the body's robe is dark blue.

Personal disciple.

These few words automatically came to mind.

Dramas and memories came flooding back, making Shi Sheng's head feel dizzy and her vision darkened. She heard the girl's voice calling her anxiously, but her consciousness was getting further and further away from her.
